name: How do I know if my drain pipes need to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my drain pipes need to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your drain pipes may need replacement include frequent clogs, slow drainage, foul odors, water stains on walls or ceilings, and visible cracks or leaks. If you notice a sudden drop in water pressure or unusually high water bills, it could also indicate a pipe issue. A professional inspection by a company like CG Plumbing Solutions can identify the exact problem and determine if replacement is necessary, especially if your home is older and has original plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for frequent clogs, slow drainage, foul odors, water stains, or visible leaks. A professional inspection can confirm the need for replacement.
